reason: I like the idea of an agent investing on payday within limits, but this is a brand-new app with no reviews and no named broker behind it, and I'm not handing my real money or my data to a cartoon pet I've never heard of. I'll keep investing myself in my broker app for now.
objection: Is my data and my money actually safe with a new app nobody has reviewed yet, and who exactly is the licensed broker that would hold my account?
would_change_my_mind: A well-known, licensed broker named as the partner holding the money, plus a solid track record of real user reviews.
